ARC 2110.title: Architecture Studio I
ARC 2110.prereqText: Portfolio acceptance, EGDT 1020 and ARC 1010 with a grade of C- or higher.

ARC 2210.title: Architecture Studio II
ARC 2210.prereqText: EGDT 1020 , ARC 1010 , and ARC 2110 with a grade of C- or higher

ARC 2220.title: Building Materials and Methods
ARC 2220.prereqText: EGDT 1020 with a grade of C- or higher and EGDT 1100 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 1010.title: Electrical Drafting and Design
EGDT 1010.prereqText: EGDT 1040 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 1100.title: Residential Architecture Documentation and Design
EGDT 1100.prereqText: EGDT 1020 with a grade of B- or higher

EGDT 1200.title: Mechanical Drafting and Design
EGDT 1200.prereqText: EGDT 1070 or EGDT 1071 or EGDT 1040 , with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 1300.title: Structural Drafting and Design
EGDT 1300.prereqText: EGDT 1040 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 1400.title: Surveying Applications and Field Techniques I

EGDT 1600.title: Technical Math Algebra
EGDT 1600.prereqText: MAT 0920 or equivalent with "C-" grade or better or appropriate test scores

EGDT 1610.title: Technical Math Geometry Trig
EGDT 1610.prereqText: EGDT 1600 or equivalent course with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2020.title: Descriptive Geometry
EGDT 2020.prereqText: EGDT 1040 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2040.title: Piping Drafting
EGDT 2040.prereqText: EGDT 1040 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2100.title: Commercial Architecture Documentation and Design
EGDT 2100.prereqText: EGDT 1020 and EGDT 1100 with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2200.title: Advanced Mechanical
EGDT 2200.prereqText: EGDT 1200 and ( EGDT 1070 or EGDT 1071 ) all with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2300.title: Advanced Structural CAD
EGDT 2300.prereqText: EGDT 1300 and ( MATH 1060 or EGDT 1610 ) both with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2310.title: Structural Steel Modeling
EGDT 2310.prereqText: EGDT 1040 and EGDT 1300 both with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2400.title: Surveying Applications and Field Techniques II
EGDT 2400.prereqText: EGDT 1040 or equivalent, EGDT 1400 and ( EGDT 1600 or MATH 1060 ) both with a grade of C- or higher

EGDT 2600.title: Applied Structures I - Statics
EGDT 2600.prereqText: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 or ( EGDT 1600 and 1610 )

EGDT 2610.title: Applied Structures II - Strength of Materials
EGDT 2610.prereqText: EGDT 2600 with a grade of B- or higher

EGDT 2810R.title: Internship
EGDT 2810R.prereqText: Department approval and completion of: EGDT 1010 , EGDT 1040 , EGDT 1070 or EGDT 1071 , EGDT 1020 , EGDT 1100 , EGDT 1200 , EGDT 1300 , and EGDT 1400 , all with a C- or higher

ENGL 1010.title: Introduction to Academic Writing
ENGL 1010.prereqText: Appropriate test scores taken within the last five years.

ENGL 2010.title: Intermediate Academic Writing
ENGL 2010.prereqText: Appropriate ACT test scores taken within the last three years or completion of ENGL 1010 or ENGL 1010H or ENGL 1005 with a grade of C- or higher.

MAT 1030.title: Quantitative Reasoning
MAT 1030.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 1020 (preferred), or MAT1015 or MAT 1010 with a grade of C– or higher; or appropriate placement by a placement exam.

MAT 1035.title: Quantitative Reasoning with Integrated Algebra
MAT 1035.prereqText: One of the following (within department time limits): MAT 0950 with a grade of C- or higher, or MAT 0980 with a grade of C- or higher, or appropriate placement by a placement exam.

MATH 1050.title: College Algebra
MATH 1050.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1055.title: College Algebra with Preliminaries
MATH 1055.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1060.title: Trigonometry
MATH 1060.prereqText: Within the past two years: MATH 1050 or MATH 1055 with a grade of C or higher or appropriate math placement score.

MATH 1090.title: College Algebra for Business
MATH 1090.prereqText: Within the past two years one of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better or appropriate math placement score.

STAT 1040.title: Introduction to Statistics
STAT 1040.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score

STAT 1045.title: Introduction to Statistics with Algebra
STAT 1045.prereqText: One of the following: MAT 1010 or MAT 1015 with a grade of C or better within the past two years; an ACT mathematics score of 23 (assuming the test has been taken within the last two years); appropriate placement by the Accuplacer test score
